szoveg_eredeti:
We're forming an alliance with McKinsey & Company to help large companies deploy and scale conversational AI agents.

 QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey , will help clients decide where agents fit, connect them to their systems, and prepare their teams to work with them. ElevenLabs will build and deploy the agents on ElevenAgents.

We’ve already worked together at KPN , the largest telecom provider in the Netherlands. KPN customers can now verify their identity, check on an order, or book a technician by talking to an agent in Dutch.

Learn more: https://lnkd.in/g9DZqgZC
